title: How to travel at the speed of light

scenes.say: Can you travel at the speed of light? Not quite.

scenes.title: Why it's so hard

items.title: Only light makes it
items.sub: It has no mass to push

scenes.say: Light covers almost 300,000 km a second. Nearing that speed takes ever more energy. Only light itself reaches it.

scenes.title: What you can do
scenes.say: Go very fast and, for you, time runs slower, so a long trip feels shorter.
